diagnostics.diagnosis: Exposed Administrative Port (SSH/22) to the open internet.
diagnostics.explanation: Exposing administrative ports to the public internet makes cloud instances vulnerable to brute-force attacks and automated scanning scripts. Corporate policy requires administrative access to be routed through a bastion host, client VPN, or restricted IP range.
diagnostics.remediation: Restricted public SSH access to the corporate intranet range (10.0.0.0/8).

diagnostics.diagnosis: Resources missing mandatory corporate metadata tags.
diagnostics.explanation: Standard SOC2 and PCI-DSS compliance audits require clear ownership, purpose, and classification tagging on all cloud infrastructure resources. Automated resource lifecycle tracking also relies on these tags.
diagnostics.remediation: Injected standardized organizational tags (Environment, Compliance, Owner) to resources.

diagnostics.explanation: Compute resource m5.large features 2 vCPUs and 8 GB of RAM. Historical metrics for standard development workloads indicate CPU utilization remains below 10%. Transitioning to a burstable general-purpose instance size (t3.medium, 2 vCPUs, 4 GB RAM) maintains performance while cutting compute baseline costs by over 50%.
diagnostics.remediation: Downgraded instance size from m5.large to right-sized t3.medium.

diagnostics.diagnosis: Expensive NAT Gateway used for basic AWS API routing.
diagnostics.explanation: NAT Gateways incur a flat hourly rate ($0.045/hr) in addition to high data processing charges ($0.045 per GB). Routing traffic to core AWS services like S3 or DynamoDB through NAT is highly inefficient. Utilizing a VPC Endpoint (PrivateLink/Gateway Endpoint) keeps traffic entirely within the AWS internal network, which eliminates data processing fees and flat routing rates.
diagnostics.remediation: Replaced NAT Gateway resource with an internal VPC Gateway Endpoint for AWS S3 and updated route tables.

diagnostics.diagnosis: FinOps Sizing and Routing Cost Audit Complete.
diagnostics.explanation: Proposed optimizations will reduce infrastructure expenses from $147.48/mo to $30.36/mo. This represents a monthly saving of $117.12 and an annualized recovery of $1,405.44 (Savings rate of 79.4%).
diagnostics.remediation: Implemented burstable CPU tiers and local VPC Gateway endpoints, preventing public transit routing charges.
